name: reconcile-splice-guard-delta-scope
body:
source: the pre-merge gate (`apg plan verify spec-splice-guard`) failed coverage-incomplete, and the reconciliation brief: every `implemented-by` claim the branch ADDS against the merge-base tree must be touched by a plan task, and the plan covers only the units this change-set creates or modifies. The branch was created from main HEAD `f3c20e4`, which is also the current default-branch HEAD, so the merge-base tree is main's tree.

inconsistency: the change-set's solution tier carried four branch-new components describing UNCHANGED context code — `solution.component.incremental-fact-store` (`rust.apg.incremental.prepare.{prepare,PipelineInput,Prepared}`), `solution.component.project-merge-rebuild` (`rust.apg.project_cmd.merge.{project_merge,project_merge_at}`), `solution.component.splice-delta-application` (`rust.apg.splice.apply.{apply,SpliceDelta,SpliceReport}`) and `solution.component.splice-publish` (`rust.apg.splice.publish.publish`, `rust.apg.load.export.write_graph_jsonl`) — so their added claims obliged plan tasks no phase owns. Three kept branch-new components also claimed unchanged units: `scan-freshness-guard` (reanchor_scan_meta, content_key, recorded_scan, cmd_scan), `splice-eligibility-guard` (recorded_content_key, seed, seed_key_matches) and `splice-equivalence-tests` (the pre-existing code-only tests `seed_copy_preserves_every_table_and_row`, `spliced_and_full_rebuild_agree_on_every_table_count`, `delta_application_matches_a_full_rebuild`, `merge_round_trip_start_mutate_verify_merge_rebuild` and the `fixture_graph` fixture). Because a branch-new node or edge is absent at the merge-base, deleting it makes it absent on BOTH sides and removes the obligation entirely; only deleting a BASE-present edge would instead create a removed-claim obligation.

resolution: (1) DELETED the four context-only components. (2) TRIMMED the three kept components' added `implemented-by` edges to exactly the units a plan task touches: `scan-freshness-guard` → {ArtifactDb.refresh_scan_row, git.state.db_recorded_scan, git.state.is_fresh, splice.seed.tree_authored_identity}; `splice-eligibility-guard` → {pipeline.try_splice_build, splice.seed.SeedFallback, splice.seed.assembled_authored_identity, splice.seed.seed_authored_identity, splice.seed.seed_checked}; `splice-equivalence-tests` → {splice_e2e.e2e.diverged_authored_rows_are_not_fast_pathed, splice_e2e.e2e.spec_only_delta_cannot_diverge_from_full_rebuild, project_cmd_e2e.e2e.merge_spec_only_lands_authored_rows_in_main_db}. The overlapping claims on reanchor_scan_meta / scan.cmd_scan / project_merge_at / load.export.write_graph_jsonl survive on base-present components (`cli-session-durability`, `cli-session-lifecycle-guards`, `cache-classification-key`, `scan-driver`, `identity-layer`) and are exempt as unchanged. (3) The deleted `project-merge-rebuild` left `domain.entity.merge-rebuild` with no `realised-by`; removed that orphan entity and its `drives` edge from `requirements.requirement.spec-only-merge-leaves-main-db-stale` — the entity described the plain unguarded main scan, which this change-set does not deliver, and the requirement still drives `domain.entity.shared-fact-store` and `domain.entity.incremental-splice`, both realised by the kept `solution.component.splice-eligibility-guard`. (4) `solution.component.test-layout → rust.apg.testutil` is deliberately LEFT UNCHANGED: it is base-present and unchanged — the branch never committed an edit to `test-layout.json` (the branch reflog names no such file) — so its claim set is identical on both sides, it is NOT an added claim, and it is NOT a coverage obligation. No `modifies` task for `rust.apg.testutil` is required; only if the gate nonetheless names it would the plan-writer add one. [with user]
